messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: runtime/container crashloop detected on cluster-prod-3 node gpu-07 — segfault in runtime_engine (native). 40% of pods in runtime-service are CrashLoopBackOff. See alert: https://ops.redwood.example/alerts/39821
eng-oncall: acked. Paging eng-runtime. I’m dropping into triage.
andrew: jumping in — thanks. quick ask: which model variant and which kernel stack? any recent deploys?
eng-oncall: no recent server-side deploys in the last 30m. Affected pods show repeated SIGSEGV during model load, stack traces point into trt_fused_kernel.so.
lia: looked at logs for one pod:
```
[2026-03-15T14:12:17Z] runtime_engine: loading weights...
[2026-03-15T14:12:18Z] trt_fused_kernel.so: segfault at 0x10 ip 0x7f3aa12345f6 sp 0x7ffc1b2a
[2026-03-15T14:12:18Z] fatal error: signal 11 (SIGSEGV)
```
eng-oncall: adding kernel devs @jason and @maya.
maya: on it. can someone paste dmesg / kernel oops from the node?
andrew: grabbing dmesg now, large NVRM GPU faults present. snippet:
```
Mar 15 14:11:58 gpu-07 kernel: NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 79, GPU has fallen off the bus.
Mar 15 14:11:58 gpu-07 kernel: general protection fault: 0000 [#1] SMP
```
maya: that looks like a GPU driver-level fault preceding the segfault. could be either bad driver or the fused kernel is making invalid CUDA calls under certain memory patterns.
eng-oncall: customers impacted?
lia: currently two Dedicated customers routing to cluster-prod-3: Acme Analytics (low-volume) and NovaChat (production traffic). NovaChat is reporting elevated 5xxs.
jason: collecting core dumps from the crashed container now. If we can get a core we can symbolicate and see whether it's a bad pointer in trt_fused_kernel.
eng-oncall: mitigation options: 1) scale down runtime-service on gpu-07 to 0; 2) cordon + drain node gpu-07; 3) temporarily route traffic away from cluster-prod-3 to cluster-prod-1/2 (fallback routing); 4) roll back to previous runtime image without fused-kernel optimizations.
andrew: recommend immediate traffic steering + cordon. scaling pod replicas will reduce churn while we capture cores. also start rolling fallback to CPU-quantized variant for NovaChat to reduce impact.
maya: agree. I’ll run cordon/drain on gpu-07, but want to keep one replica so we can collect core. doing: `kubectl cordon gpu-07` -> done.
maya: `kubectl drain gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force` -> pods evicted, runtime-service scaled down, leaving one crashlooping pod for core capture.
jason: core collected at /var/crash/runtime_core_gpu07_2723456789.dump; uploading to S3: s3://redwood-cores/2723456789.dump.gz
lia: alerting NovaChat SREs via email and status page: "We are investigating a runtime crashloop affecting model-serving in us-west-2; transient errors and elevated latency may occur. Mitigation in progress."
eng-oncall: routing change: triggering routing policy to shift 75% of traffic off cluster-prod-3 to cluster-prod-1/2 for affected routes. Command: `redwoodctl route set --service runtime --region us-west-2 --weight 25% --target cluster-prod-3`
andrew: started a canary rollback to previous runtime image tag `runtime:v2026-03-10` on a subset of nodes (cluster-prod-3 unaffected).
maya: quick note — GPU driver versions on gpu-07: 535.86, while other nodes run 535.90. mismatch could explain NVRM faults under certain code paths. ops-infra, can we patch drivers?
eng-oncall: ops-infra pinged. immediate driver update risky mid-incident. plan: keep node cordoned, shift traffic, collect cores, then reproduce in staging with same driver.
jason: symbolication shows crash in `trt_fused_kernel::launch_batched(...)` touching freed memory — looks like a race in KV cache handling with fused kernels on older driver.
lia: customer impact update: NovaChat 5xxs at 2.3% of requests in last 10m, RTT increased. support notified on Slack.
eng-oncall: decision: 1) keep gpu-07 cordoned; 2) route traffic away from cluster-prod-3 until a safe rollback or kernel disable; 3) push emergency config to runtime to disable TRT fused kernels for production models in us-west-2: `RUNTIME_DISABLE_TRT_FUSED=true` (rolling config).
andrew: deploying config flag now to runtime-service in us-west-2 (canary first).
maya: can confirm config disables the fused path; if load time uses fallback kernels we should avoid the segfault. monitoring pods...
eng-oncall: monitoring: crashloop count dropping, NovaChat 5xxs trending down.
lia: posting incident note to #status with initial mitigation summary and ETA for next update in 30m.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0325-72, severity P1, channel #incidents. Pager history recorded.
eng-oncall: performing handoff — I'm going to hand over to night oncall @maya in ~20min. key things for next oncall: 1) confirm cores fully analyzed by jason; 2) test rollout of runtime:v2026-03-10 or leave fused disabled; 3) coordinate with ops-infra for driver parity across nodes.
maya: ack, taking over at 14:35UTC. will continue monitoring, coordinate postmortem and customer comms.
andrew: thanks team. leaving logs/commands in the incident doc.
eng-oncall: closing active pager for me, but incident remains open. tagging follow-ups: /followups triage-core-analysis, driver-parity, canary-rollback.
maya: adding note: create postmortem and include reproduction steps, core analysis, and recommended safe default to disable fused kernels until driver fix merged.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Handoff recorded: eng-oncall -> maya at 2723457100
